title: One-Pot Chicken Burrito Bowl
equip: Instant Pot, Philips hand blender (chopper attachment)

items.n: boneless chicken thigh, cut into 2.5cm cubes

items.sub: 1 Santa Maria taco spice mix sachet (then skip the salt and other spices)

items.n: chicken stock (1/2 Knorr chicken cube dissolved in hot water)
can black beans (400g), drained and rinsed
long grain or jasmine rice, rinsed until water runs clear
Coriander leaves and hot sauce to taste

steps.x: Set the Instant Pot to Sauté (High). Heat the oil, add onion and capsicum, and cook 3 min until softened.
Add the chicken and all spices. Stir for 2 min until the chicken is coated and turning opaque at the edges.
Turn off Sauté. Pour in the stock and scrape every bit off the bottom. This is the main defence against a burn warning.

Spread the beans and corn over the chicken, then pour the tomatoes over evenly. Scatter the rinsed rice on top and press it down with a spoon so it's just submerged. Do not stir after adding the rice.
Lock the lid with the vent on Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 6 min, then natural release for 10 min and release the rest.
Add the lime juice and gently fold everything together with a fork, without over-stirring or the rice turns mushy. Close the lid (not sealed) and rest 5 min to absorb any remaining liquid.
Divide into 4 Glasslocks. Pack the yogurt, lettuce and salsa separately (partitioned container) so they stay cold and fresh.

notes: Approx. per portion: 530 kcal, 38g protein including yogurt.
Kid-friendly as-is: there's no chilli in the base. Adults add hot sauce or sliced chilli at serving.
Fridge: 3 days. Cool the rice quickly (spread it in containers, into the fridge within 1 hour) and reheat until steaming hot throughout.
Freezer: 2 months without toppings; reheat from frozen 4 min, stirring halfway.
Burn warning mid-cook: cancel, quick release, scrape the bottom, add 60ml water around the edge (not stirred in), and restart for the remaining time.
Also works as burrito filling: wrap in a tortilla with the yogurt and lettuce.
